hook: He bribed a hospital clerk to change his records to 'deceased,' then walked out of the prison wing wearing a dead body bag—that was his roommate's.
why_this_can_go_viral: Escape stories are viral catnip—this one has a macabre twist that makes it unforgettable.

title: The Cartel That Built a Drug Submarine—From Inside a Prison Workshop
hook: Inmates welded a 50-foot narco-sub in a prison metal shop, using tools meant for making license plates, and launched it into the Pacific the day they were released.

title: The Heist Where Thieves Stole $1 Billion in Art—and Hid Everything Inside a Single Piano

title: The Unsolved Murder Where the Killer Wrote a Poem About the Crime—and Mailed It to the Victim's Mother Every Year

why_this_can_go_viral: Emotional and deeply unsettling—the mother's story and the poetic taunt create a narrative that demands sharing.

title: The Serial Killer Who Used a Police Scanner—to Arrive at Crime Scenes Before the Cops

why_this_can_go_viral: The ultimate 'wolf in sheep's clothing' story—viewers feel betrayed for the police who thanked him.

title: The Mob That Used a Car Dealership to Launder Money—by Selling the Same Car 200 Times

why_this_can_go_viral: The 'beat the bank at its own game' story appeals to anti-establishment sentiment and financial curiosity.

title: The Heist Where Thieves Stole a Train Full of Gold—by Replacing a Single Rail Switch at Midnight
